scope: Independent bounded review of the specified first stable root fixes only; router additions excluded as requested.
reviewMode: git diff plus implementation/caller context and associated assertions, not full-repository acceptance

findings.issue: The guard accepts the actual TypeScript syntax --noEmit false, permitting emission through a readonly command.
findings.repro: checkTerminalCommandAllowlist('tsc --noEmit false',['tsc']) => {safe:true}; TypeScript.parseCommandLine(['--noEmit','false']) => noEmit:false with zero errors. Repeated ['--noEmit','--noEmit','false'] also produces false. Equals forms --noEmit=false and --noEmit=true instead yield TS5023.
findings.suggestion: Parse sequential --noEmit flags and optional adjacent true/false values; require final effective noEmit=true. Test split false and repeated override.
findings.testAssessment: The added --noEmit=false case rejects a compiler-invalid form and misses the genuine emit-enabling form.
findings.certainty: pure-function reproduction; no compilation or writes

findings.issue: JSON-key support does not redact the complete JSON string. Whitespace leaks suffixes; escaped quotes break JSON and leak suffixes.
findings.suggestion: Match quoted JSON keys and full escape-aware JSON string values before legacy bare key=value handling; replace the entire value and preserve valid JSON. Add spaces, escaped quotes and backslashes to synthetic value tests.
findings.testAssessment: New tests cover only long single-token values. Existing assertions remain.
findings.certainty: source import pure-function reproduction, synthetic inputs only

findings.issue: handleStructure passes a canonical absDir and lexical projectRoot to buildDirectoryTree; the resulting path.relative header escapes the visible project for legitimate symlinked roots.
findings.repro: On this host resolveProjectPath('/tmp','.') => {absolute:'/private/tmp',relative:''}; path.relative('/tmp','/private/tmp') => '../private/tmp'. Structure therefore prints '../private/tmp/' instead of './'.
findings.suggestion: Use one canonical root throughout the tree renderer, or render from the verified relative coordinate. Add a symlinked-project-root structure case.
findings.testAssessment: New tests cover file symlink denial/protected targets but omit a legitimate symlinked projectRoot.
findings.certainty: actual helper/path probe plus direct call-chain inspection; regression introduced by this patch

checks.reason: String-state scanning preserves commas/brackets/fences/escape state and repairs only structural trailing commas. Complete and truncated response tests both exercise preservation; old parsing coverage remains.

Nullish retries preserves zero; shared reliability also uses nullish defaults. Post-import gateway double-check closes the race because assignment follows synchronously. The concurrent mocked-fetch test uses the real provider gateway.
Whitespace and escaped-value gaps remain; no existing test weakened.

Lexical and realpath containment agree; missing paths walk existing ancestors and dangling symlinks are refused. Judge rejects absolute/invalid ranges and nonpositive caps. Existing normal-slice tests and new traversal/symlink tests preserve coverage.

checks.group: code file paths and range rereads
checks.reason: Read/write freshness and protected targets consistently use canonical relative paths. Explicit ranges bypass unchanged-cache short circuit, matching delta behavior. New small/full and large/outline tests cover range rereads. Structure rendering mixes roots. Router changes deliberately excluded.
Newlines/variables/find execution-output/rg preprocessors are blocked on the allowlisted route while unrestricted behavior remains. TypeScript boolean syntax still bypasses the check.

Removing title-based call dedup preserves call/result pairing and retry outcomes; both resets clear projection threshold. Forced thresholds exercise L2/L3 and check IDs plus projection without removing previous assertions.

Shared ID validation precedes raw fs and WriteZone writes/deletes; load/summarize use it too. Byte snapshot check after model await prevents same-process lost updates before synchronous replacement. New tests cover traversal and append-during-summary.

validation.method: Read source/diffs/tests; pure probes of Redaction, terminalSafety, TypeScript.parseCommandLine, resolveProjectPath/path.relative. Synthetic inputs only. Root owns test execution and acceptance.

optionalTestImprovements: Zero retries currently asserted on constructor state; an additional mocked retryable error with one-fetch assertion would prove request behavior, although source delegation correctly preserves zero.
Add legitimate symlinked projectRoot and dangling-target cases to path helper coverage.
Conversation summary deletion/second-summary races share the guarded branch; optional table cases can complement the existing append-during-await test.
